title: OpenSAI DAG Specification
description: Agent-friendly JSON DAG description for OpenSAI computation offloading.

taskName.description: Human-readable name for this DAG task.

taskDesc.description: Optional longer description of the DAG purpose.

nodes.description: Ordered list of computation nodes forming the DAG.

id.description: Unique node identifier within this DAG (1-based).

name.description: Optional human-readable label for this node.

algorithm.description: Name of the registered algorithm to execute (e.g. Algorithm_Pi_Calculation).

params.description: Parameters to pass to the algorithm's run() method as param_dict.

dependsOn.description: IDs of nodes that must complete before this node can run (beforeNodes).

directAllocationId.description: Target device ID: -1 = smart placement, >0 = pin to specific device.
